question: To which deities must offerings be given in the eastern and southern directions?
premises: Offerings are to be given in the east
The Rudras are the recipients in the east
The Mothers are the recipients in the south
inference: One should give offerings to the Rudras in the east and likewise to the Mothers in the south.
plain_english: One should give to the Rudras in the east, and likewise to the Mothers in the south.
